parameters.name: EnableTagAuthorization
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable tag-based authorization.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. If you do not specify this parameter, all instances are queried.

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description:
The language of the response. The descriptions of system policies are returned in this language.

- en: English.

- zh: Chinese.

- ja: Japanese.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are attached to the instance.
